new_jobs.title: Sr. Supply Chain Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Overview** Microsoft’s Cloud business is expanding, and the Cloud Supply Chain (CSCP) organization is responsible for enabling the hardware infrastructure underlying this growth including AI! CSCP’s vision is to empower customers to achieve more by delivering Cloud and AI capabilities at scale. Our mission is to deliver the world's computer with an industry\-leading supply chain. The CSCP organization is responsible for traditional supply chain functions such as plan, source, make, deliver, but also manages supportability (spares), sustainability, and decommissioning of datacenter assets worldwide. We deliver the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform for external customers. Our infrastructure is supported by more than 300 datacenters around the world that enable services for more than 1 billion customers in over 90 countries. The Cloud Sourcing, Security and Sustainability (CS3\) organization within CSCP manages sourcing, strategy, and suppliers to provide cost, flexibility, and supply advantages that enable our org to become a world\-class supply chain. Well\-defined and executed sourcing and supply chain management ensures reliable, on\-time performance and optimized cost, prevents urgent and unplanned investments, and provides accurate and timely information across the supply base and internally across the infrastructure organization. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **\#CSCP \#CSCPJobs** **Responsibilities** * Collaborate with suppliers, execution, fulfillment, and logistics teams to overcome obstacles and align build plans, ensuring continuous supply chain flow. * Meet regularly with assigned suppliers to review NPI build target demand, capture supply commitments and publish internally. * Review all POs placed by Microsoft System Integrators and assure compliance and supportability against our 3PL inventory positioning. * Manage metrics including supply, E\&O (Excess \& Obsolete), and shortages within lead time at each supplier to improve performance. * Work with engineering teams, sourcing managers, supply chain, and capacity planning teams to manage the timing, availability, and ramp\-up of new platforms. * Perform scenario analysis to understand the impact of component shortages, demand changes, and other variables on the supply plan of record. * Identify process improvement opportunities and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement better tools and processes to meet global demand. * Drive SI/ODM (System Integrator/Original Design Manufacturer) for multi\-source and multi\-geo initiatives to achieve internal annual targets. * Provide leadership in scenario analysis, strategic program management, and the alignment of build plans with compliance and executive directives. * Foster a data\-driven culture by overseeing strategic data processes, promoting continuous improvement, and sharing insights with executive leadership. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Supply Chain Analytics, or related field AND 7\+ years supply planning, operations, supply chain, indirect supply planning, technology\-related supply chain, sourcing and manufacturing, Sales \& Operations Planning, materials requirement planning systems and tools, quantitative \& qualitative analysis in cross functional or organizational enterprise environment, or related experience OR Master's Degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Supply Chain Analytics, or related field AND 5\+ years supply planning, operations, supply chain, indirect supply planning, technology\-related supply chain, sourcing and manufacturing, Sales \& Operations Planning, materials requirement planning systems and tools, quantitative \& qualitative analysis in cross functional or organizational enterprise environment, or related experience OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements** * Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements. These include, but are not limited to: + Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications** * 8\+ years in electronics manufacturing supply planning or similar role. * Bachelor’s degree in supply chain or related field. * Broad knowledge of electronics manufacturing processes, including PCBA, interconnect, mechanicals, power supply units, thermal solutions, and logistics. * Experience in inventory management. * Fluency in English. * Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Supply Chain Analytics, or related field AND 8\+ years supply planning, operations, supply chain, indirect supply planning, technology\-related supply chain, sourcing and manufacturing, Sales \& Operations Planning, material requirement planning systems and tools, quantitative \& qualitative analysis in cross\-functional or organizational enterprise environments, or related experience OR Master's Degree in related field AND 6\+ years relevant work experience. This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. new_jobs.jd: We are seeking an experienced **Director of Automated Warehouse** to oversee our automated logistics facility. This leadership role is responsible for driving operational excellence, managing automated systems (AS/RS, AGV/AMR), leading logistics and maintenance teams, and ensuring strict compliance with semiconductor handling standards (ESD/MSL). If you have a proven track record in high\-tech warehouse leadership and large\-scale automation, we welcome your application. **Key Responsibilities** **\[Team Leadership]** * Oversee warehouse operations, automation maintenance, and inbound/outbound logistics teams. * Manage shift planning, and direct skill development programs. * Ensure full compliance with WSH standards and labor regulations. **\[System Operations \& Process Governance]** * Direct the operations and integration of AS/RS, AGV/AMR, and WMS systems. * Establish and enforce SOPs for ESD protection and MSL environment control. * Optimize kitting, inventory counting, and picking workflows to maximize order accuracy and system uptime. * Enforce strict lot control and full inventory traceability across the supply chain. **\[Strategic \& Capital Management]** * Develop and execute long\-term strategies for warehouse automation upgrades and facility expansion. * Manage annual OPEX and CAPEX budgets to ensure cost efficiency and ROI on automation investments. * Analyze inventory turnover and logistics metrics to reduce import/export and regional distribution costs. **Qualifications** * **10\+ years** of warehouse management experience in the electronics/semiconductor industry, including **5\+ years** in a senior leadership role. * Proven track record in managing large\-scale automated warehouses (AS/RS, WMS). * In\-depth knowledge of ESD precautions and MSL component handling for IC/semiconductor products. * Hands\-on experience with **SAP EWM** . * Strong business English communication skills (written and spoken). We are looking for someone who is intellectually curious, analytical, and comfortable working through complexity. Someone who can: * Structure ambiguous problems and work through them logically. * Move from operational data to actionable insights, and from insights to cost\-effective logistics strategies. * Build and improve automated systems and protocols rather than simply operate existing processes. * Challenge existing warehouse practices with sound analysis and solid business rationale. * Remain hands\-on and comfortable working through operational details when necessary. Most importantly, we are looking for a builder who wants to help create a smarter, more data\-driven, and highly resilient automated logistics operation from Headquarters.

new_jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Sr. Manager
new_jobs.jd: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. **The Role** The Senior Manager of Supply Chain Strategy is an individual contributor to own end to end supply chain strategy for overall rack\-level components within the rack. You will partner with engineering, product management, procurement, and OEM/ ODM partners to build a supply chain that is resilient, cost competitive, and capable of scaling to meet rapidly growing demand in the AI infrastructure market. **The Person** Description of what type of person would be successful in the role and any characteristics needed. (typically soft skills). **Key Responsibilities** Supply Chain Strategy \& Architecture * Define and own the multi\-year supply chain strategy for Helios rack\-level components, including power delivery units, all cabling, cooling systems (air \& liquid), mechanical rack structures, and system PCBA, and management controllers. * Evaluate and recommend make\-vs.\-buy and direct\-vs.\-distribution sourcing models for each component category, balancing cost, quality, flexibility, and geopolitical risk. * Develop rack\-level bill\-of\-material (BoM) supply strategies that align with product roadmap milestones and customer delivery commitments. Supplier Strategy \& Ecosystem Development * Lead strategic supplier selection, qualification, and dual/multi\-sourcing programs for critical rack\-level commodities — including sheet metal fabrication, power electronics, thermal modules, cable assemblies, and embedded management firmware components. * Come out long\-term supply agreements, capacity reservations, and pricing frameworks with tier\-1 and tier\-2 suppliers in collaboration with Procurement. * Establish supplier scorecards and governance cadences; drive corrective actions for quality, delivery, or capacity shortfalls. Demand Planning \& Inventory Optimization * Define inventory positioning strategy (safety stock, buffer stock, strategic reserve) for long\-lead and sole\-sourced rack components to protect customer commitments. * Drive S\&OP integration for rack components, ensuring supply\-demand alignment is reviewed and escalated to leadership on a monthly cadence. New Product Introduction (NPI) Supply Chain Readiness * Embed supply chain strategy into the Helios product development lifecycle from concept through production ramp, owning supply readiness gates at each phase review. * Identify and mitigate supply constraints for next\-generation rack components (e.g., Mi400\-series accelerators, next\-gen liquid cooling loops, next\-gen network switch ASICs) 12–24 months ahead of introduction. * Define contract manufacturer (CM) and original design manufacturer (ODM) strategy for rack assembly and integration, including capacity, quality systems, and logistics flows. Risk Management \& Supply Continuity * Maintain a living supply chain risk register; quantify financial and schedule exposure for each risk and own mitigation plans. * Lead response to supply disruptions (allocation shortfalls, geopolitical events, natural disasters, factory incidents), coordinating cross\-functionally to protect customer deliveries. * Drive geographic diversification and resiliency programs — e.g., qualifying alternate assembly sites, reducing single\-country dependencies for critical components. Cost \& Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) Optimization * Model and track total landed cost for rack configurations; identify and implement cost\-reduction opportunities across component, logistics, and assembly layers. * Partner with engineering to influence design\-for\-supply\-chain choices (standard interfaces, modular designs, component commonality) that lower cost and complexity. * Develop should\-cost models for key rack commodities to anchor supplier negotiations and benchmark market competitiveness. Executive Reporting \& Cross\-Functional Leadership * Own supply chain KPI reporting for Helios rack programs: on\-time delivery, component availability, inventory turns, supply risk exposure, and cost\-to\-plan. * Present supply chain status, risks, and strategic recommendations to AMD executive leadership (VP/SVP level) on a regular cadence. **Preferred Experience** * 15\+ years of progressive supply chain experience in semiconductor, server/systems hardware, or high\-technology manufacturing environments. * Demonstrated expertise in supply chain strategy for complex multi\-component hardware systems (rack, blade, server, networking, or storage platforms preferred). * Experience owning supplier strategy and negotiations for high\-value, long\-lead commodities (power electronics, advanced packaging, or mechanical systems a plus). * Strong analytical foundation: demand/supply modeling, inventory optimization, should\-cost analysis, and scenario planning. * Track record of cross\-functional influence without direct authority across engineering, finance, sales, and operations. * Excellent executive communication skills — able to synthesize complex supply chain tradeoffs into clear narratives and recommendations. **Academic Credentials** * Bachelor's degree in business administration, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain Management or related field preferred. **LOCATION:** Taipei, Taiwan *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.* *AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. new_jobs.jd: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The RAPID division leads the industry in reticle inspection solutions, helping ensure high lithography yields and cost\-effective semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems support both mask shops and fabs by detecting defects early in the process, enabling faster, more reliable production. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. Lead and evolve global electrical engineering standards, specifications, and design guidelines across a diverse facilities portfolio. Review electrical designs for capital projects, infrastructure upgrades, and critical facility improvements to support consistency, quality, and compliance. Guide technical strategy for power distribution, UPS, generators, transfer systems, and other critical power infrastructure. Partner with cross\-functional teams to improve resiliency, operational readiness, and long\-term facility performance. Support renewable energy and electrification initiatives, including solar, battery storage, EV charging, and utility coordination where relevant. Translate technical requirements into clear standards, design guidance, and executive\-ready summaries. **Preferred Qualifications** KLA is seeking a motivated leader to manage a world\-class algorithm team within the reticle product division (RAPID). The successful candidate will lead the development of advanced algorithm solutions for next\-generation reticle inspection imaging systems. * Provide onsite algorithm technical support throughout the full product lifecycle * Collaborate with the TSMC business unit and GSS (Global Service Support) to identify root causes and address issues * Lead algorithm solution development for anomaly detection, from requirements and concept design to prototyping and product deployment * Develop machine learning and traditional algorithm solutions using C\+\+ and CUDA * Work cross\-functionally to promote technical excellence and agile development practices, with a strong emphasis on customer satisfaction. * Occasional travel to headquarters is required **Preferred Qualifications And Attributes** * Master’s or Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline * Extensive experience applying image processing, machine learning, or deep learning to advanced imaging systems * Required: production software development in C\+\+ using object\-oriented programming principles * Required: CUDA and GPU\-accelerated computing * Preferred: leading and mentoring engineering teams on multi\-year projects **Minimum Qualifications** Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Use of AI Statement** At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. *We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.* *KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*
